main.description: A moderation label, written by the group authority into the space its subject lives in — or, for an account, into the members space.

subject.description: A record inside one of the group's spaces, or an account. A record's label lives in that record's space; an account's in the members space.

val.description: The label value, e.g. '!hide', '!takedown', or a group-defined value.

neg.description: If true, negates an earlier label with the same val on the same subject.
